title: Live Robinhood dip bot (today's live rules)
rules: S&P 500 stock above its 200-day average that fell 10%+ more than SPY over 5 days, 5-day volume not over 2x normal; biggest dips first, up to 10 x 10%; sell first close above the 5-day average or after 5 days; idle money in the Clear Leader ETF when SPY > 100-day average, else cash. 3:47 pm ET on an Oracle VM.
result: 1998-2026 realistic 14.9%/yr (ideal fills 22.0%), after tax ~11.9%, worst drop -25 to -28%. Live since Nov 2026 with ~$100; halts at -40% from peak.
verdict: LIVE. Planned switch to v3.0 rules around Dec 3 if paper bot 10 stays clean.

title: Dip bot v3.0 = live rules + ETF dips + bonds when weak (paper bot 10)
rules: Live stock rules; free slots go to index/sector/country ETFs down 5%+ in 5 days and above their 200-day (held up to 10 days); idle money: Clear Leader when SPY > 100-day, else IEF bonds if IEF > its 100-day, else cash.
result: 1999-2026 realistic 16.6%/yr vs 13.4% for live rules (same test); ideal 22.8 vs 18.5. Better in both halves and with doubled costs. Worst drop ~ -27%.

title: Dip bot v3.1 = v3.0 + 2 earnings-drift slots (paper bot 11)
rules: v3.0 plus 2 of the 10 slots reserved for earnings-drift buys (stock beat SPY by 4-6%+ on its earnings day, hold 60 days).
result: Adds ~0.5-1%/yr over v3.0 in 1999-2026 but the drift edge has faded since 2021 (v3.2 + 2 drift: 31.0% vs 30.5%, worse 2021-26).

title: Dip bot v3.2 = v3.0 + intraday dip buys every 15 min + 5% profit target (paper bot 12)
rules: v3.0, but dips are also bought during the day (checks every 15 minutes on 5-minute bars) and a position is sold intraday at +5%.
result: 2016-2026 5-minute replay 30.5%/yr vs v3.0 27.2%; 2x costs 27.9 vs 25.4; better in 9 of 11 years (worse 2023, 2024).
verdict: Watch on paper (started late: Friday timer bug).

title: Volatility-sized dip buys (paper bot 2)
rules: Live rules, but position size scales with market jumpiness: 0.5x when calm, up to 1.5x when SPY is volatile.
result: 16.1%/yr, worst -25% vs 14.9% / -26% (gain mostly 2008-09); 4 of 4 versions better.

title: ETF dips in free slots (paper bot 5)
rules: Live stock rules + 29 index/sector/country ETFs: 5-day drop >= 5%, above 200-day, buy at the close, sell back above the 5-day average (max 10 days).
result: Combined 17.1%/yr, worst -22.4% vs 14.9% / -26.7%; better in both halves.

title: Bonds instead of cash when stocks are weak (paper bot 9)
rules: Idle money in IEF (7-10 yr Treasuries) when SPY is below its 100-day average and IEF is above its own 100-day average.
result: Adds ~0.5-1%/yr with the same worst drop.

title: Skip dips in heavily shorted stocks (paper bot 8)
rules: Live rules, but skip a dip if days-to-cover (FINRA short interest, 12-day lag) is 5 or more. Data only from Dec 2017.
result: Small, noisy gain on 2018-2026 only.

title: Tuned dip settings + ETF dips (paper bot 6)
rules: Tuned version of the dip rules (settings in scripts/paper-dip.mjs) plus the ETF sleeve.
result: Backtest ~19.4%/yr in the 52-week-high test runs (ideal fills).

title: 6 dip slots + 4 earnings-drift slots (paper bot 7)
rules: One account: 6 dip slots + 4 drift slots (caps matter).
result: 2004-2026 realistic 15.8%/yr (ideal 19.1%), after tax 12.3%, worst -24%; 45 nearby versions beat SPY.

title: Earnings drift, blend of 9 (paper bot 3, Alpaca $100k)
rules: Stock beat SPY by >= 4-6% on its earnings reaction day (SEC 8-K 2.02 timing); buy next open, hold 60 trading days.
result: ~13%/yr before tax, worst -51%; out-of-sample 2004-2015 ok, faded since 2021.

title: v3.0 with 1.5x / 2x leverage on dip stocks (2x ETF or margin)
rules: Same signals; each dip stock held at 1.5x or 2x. Costs: 2x-ETF style (borrow + 1.1% fee) or margin (T-bill + 3%). Variant: leverage only when SPY > 100-day.
result: Running (data/lev_single.json).

title: VIX gate on the dip bot
rules: Only buy dips when VIX is in a chosen band.
result: Did not fix the weak 2013-2019 stretch (best ~9.3%/yr).

title: Sector-relative dips
rules: Measure the dip against the stock's sector ETF instead of SPY (or both).
result: Worse than vs-SPY dips.

title: Stress test: beta, alpha, kill switch
rules: Split v3.0 returns into market (beta) and own edge (alpha); resampled 3-year drawdowns.
result: Beta 0.45, alpha ~17%/yr but ~0 in 2013-2019; kill switch set at -40%.

title: Blend: SPY + dip bot + Faber trend sleeve
rules: Mixes of SPY buy & hold, v3.0 and a 5-ETF 10-month trend sleeve, monthly rebalance.
result: No mix beat the dip bot alone after tax.

title: Same-day sell at +5%
rules: Sell a dip position the same day if it is up 5% intraday.
result: 31.1%/yr but better in only 3 of 11 years.

title: Slot count and dip size
rules: 3-15 slots; dip threshold 8-14%.
result: 10 slots and a 10% dip are the peak; 3 slots 7.8%/yr, -57% worst.

title: Wash-sale cooldown (no re-buy within 31 days of a loss)
rules: Skip re-buying a ticker within 31 days of a losing sale (or only in December).
result: After tax unchanged (19.5% live-like).

title: News proxies (gaps, 8-K filings, shocks)
rules: Skip dips with earnings, 8-K news, one-day shocks, gaps, Fed days etc.
result: All inside the random-skip range.

title: Stop-losses / trailing stops
rules: Exit a dip at a fixed loss or trailing stop.
result: Cuts the winners; lower return.

title: Insider buying as a dip filter
rules: Only buy dips with recent officer/director buying (SEC Form 4).
result: No gain.

title: Rank dips by distance from the 52-week high
rules: Buy dips 20%+ below the 52-week high first.
result: 14.4 vs 14.9%/yr (noise).

title: Candles: dips that closed at the low
rules: Prefer dips that closed at the day's low.
result: 17.4 vs 17.1%/yr with a deeper worst drop.

title: Managed-futures slice next to v3.0 (Roth)
rules: Add 10-30% AQMIX / DBMF / KMLM, monthly rebalance.
result: Return falls in proportion (20.2 -> 17.2%/yr with 20% AQMIX since 2010), Sharpe +0.03. Next to SPY it helps a lot (worst -24 -> -13 to -16%).
verdict: Not beside the dip bot; maybe beside an SPY core.

title: 2x S&P 500 with a 200-day trend filter (2% band)
rules: Hold a 2x S&P fund (SSO) after SPY closes 2% above its 200-day average; T-bills after it closes 2% below. ~1.5 switches a year. Roth (no tax on switches).
result: SPY 1994-2026: 14.4%/yr, worst -42% vs SPY 10.4% / -55%. Robustness: 16 nearby settings 7.7-15.4% (median 12.5); 10% of random schedules beat it; works on Nasdaq/intl, fails on small caps/EM/Dow; helps in slow bears (2000-02, 2008), hurts in fast ones (2020 -40%, 2018 -27%); 21 of 23 start years beat SPY.
verdict: Watch: real but fragile; at most a small Roth sleeve.

title: 2x single stocks (Oracle-style ETFs) with a trend filter
rules: Hold a stock at 2x while it is 2% above its 200-day average, else T-bills. Fair test: every S&P 500 member on 2000-01-03 (incl. losers); hindsight list: ORCL, NVDA, TSLA...
result: Running.

title: Clear Leader v2.0 (monthly ETF leader)
rules: Monthly: hold the strongest of a small ETF set (124,416-combo grid).
verdict: Kept only to choose where idle dip money parks.

title: Quality at a fair price screener
rules: Profitable, growing, ROE >= 12%, FCF > 0, debt <= equity, P/E <= 40; rank half quality, half value; hold 12 months.
result: 2013-2026 15.8%/yr vs SPY 14.0%; 9 of 11 nearby versions beat SPY.

title: Net buybacks (top 10 share shrinkers)
rules: Monthly: 10 S&P 500 stocks whose share count fell most over a year; hold >= 63 days.
result: 17.8%/yr vs SPY 13.9%, worst -43%; but one stock (WDC) added ~30 pts and it beat SPY in only 8 of 16 years.
verdict: Maybe later as a small sleeve.

title: Opening-range breakout and intraday rules
rules: ORB 5-min/1-min, half-hour, SPY noise-area momentum, Ledger scan.
result: ORB ~ -8%/yr even at zero cost; SPY momentum ~0% since May 2024.

title: Single-stock intraday rhythms
rules: ~800 intraday / 1-3 day rules per stock (ORCL, NVDA, TSLA, AMD, PLTR, COIN).
result: Nothing beat costs.

title: RSI(2) dip
rules: Buy when 2-day RSI is very low.
result: Below the dip strategy.

title: ATR swing trading
rules: Buy with a direction filter, sell at k x ATR target, 1-3 day hold (384 versions).
result: Loses; an earlier 134%/yr was a data artifact.

title: Short selling (all kinds)
rules: Mirror dip, mirror drift, SPY short, lottery, losers, long/short, hedged dip.

title: Buying options (calls, protective puts)
rules: Calls on signals; protective puts.

title: Selling puts (Cboe PutWrite index)
rules: Sell monthly cash-secured S&P puts.

title: Future leaders (let winners run momentum)
rules: Momentum leaders held long.

title: Insider buying clusters
rules: Buy stocks with clusters of officer/director buying.
result: Failed unseen years (12.3% vs SPY 14.9% in 2016-26).

title: S&P 500 additions / removals
rules: Buy joiners or removed stocks.
result: Joiners lag; removal bounce only worked 1999-2012.

title: 52-week-high momentum
rules: Buy stocks at 52-week highs.

title: Spin-offs
rules: Buy new spin-offs, hold 1 year.
result: Median -2.4% vs SPY; a few huge winners.

title: Overnight-only SPY
rules: Buy at the close, sell at the open.
result: 9.9%/yr before costs; ~0 after 0.02%/side.

title: Pre-FOMC drift
rules: Hold SPY on Fed announcement days.
result: Faded after 2011.

title: 13F best ideas
rules: Top holdings of concentrated managers.
result: No edge after the 45-day filing lag.

title: Chart patterns
rules: Breakouts, flags, VCP, H&S, double bottoms.
result: ~0 after costs.

title: Crabel NR7 / NR4 breakout
rules: Narrowest range of 7 days, buy above its high.
result: All 12 versions lose.

title: Pattern matching / lookalikes
rules: Nearest-neighbour on the last 10-40 daily moves.
result: Nothing real.

title: Volatile-stock bounce
rules: ~10k bounce scenarios on volatile names.
result: Filters help a little; no tradable edge.

title: Covered-call ETFs (JEPI, QYLD)
rules: Hold covered-call income ETFs.
result: Since 2020: JEPI 10.2%, QYLD 8.5% vs SPY 15.5%.

title: Bitcoin 10-month trend
rules: Hold Bitcoin (spot ETF) while above its 10-month average, else cash; checked monthly.
result: 2014-2026 ~60%/yr vs hold 49%; worst -72% vs -83%; 2022 +2% vs -65%. Robust for crash protection, not for extra return (only 2.8% of random schedules beat it).

title: Ether trend rules
rules: Same trend rules on Ether.
result: Inconsistent.

title: When to send USD -> INR
rules: Convert $1,000/month on the 1st vs when the dollar is strong (above 50-day / 60-day high, max wait 3 months).
result: Every rule within -0.25..0% of converting on the 1st (2004-2026); rupee weakened 3.2%/yr.

title: India via US-listed ETFs for the Roth (INDA / SMIN)
rules: Hold or rotate INDA, SMIN, EPI, GLD, cash.
result: INDA 6.7%/yr vs SPY 13.4% (2013-2026); no rotation beat SPY.

title: India momentum basket (paper bot 13, 'this month's 20')
rules: Top 500 NSE stocks by traded value; score (6m+12m return)/volatility; hold top 20 equal weight; reshuffle on the 1st trading day of each month; keep while in the top 30; crash filter: Nifty below its 100-day average -> GOLDBEES (if gold above its 100-day) else liquid fund.
result: 2009-2026 survivorship-free: 32.6%/yr best case, ~27% realistic (honest), worst -24 to -34%; lot-level after tax 22.6% realistic vs Nifty 14.5%.

title: India Alpha 50, our version (paper bot 14)
rules: Top 300 by traded value; 1-year Jensen's alpha vs Nifty; top 50 equal weight; quarterly (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct); no crash filter.
result: 2009-2026 22.0%/yr, worst -47% (no trading costs); plan 17-20%; after tax barely above Nifty.

title: India dip bot (virtual Rs 10 lakh)
rules: India version of the US dip rules (5-day 12% vs Nifty, top 200, 200-day).
result: 14.0%/yr (worst -19.5%) = Nifty 14.5%; loses after tax.

title: Momentum crash filter: 100-day vs 200-day
rules: Nifty vs its 100- or 200-day average at each reshuffle.
result: 100-day 32.6% / -23.8 vs 200-day 30.6% / -37.5; 100-day wins in all split tests.

title: Momentum: weekly reshuffle
rules: Reshuffle weekly instead of monthly.
result: Worse; worst drop -58.8%.

title: Momentum: stops, daily checks, vol targets
rules: Stop-losses, trailing stops, drawdown stop, volatility targeting.
result: None helped.

title: Momentum: split the reshuffle across days
rules: 2-4 parts reshuffled on different days.
result: Averages day luck (26.7-29.2%), no smaller drops, double the orders.

title: Momentum: junk filters
rules: Skip circuit-locked stocks, bottom-10% turnover, -10% days (on 3x volume).
result: All within +-0.5 pt.

title: Momentum: per-stock check (12m > liquid and above own 200-day)
rules: Fill a slot only with stocks passing the check.
result: +0.6 pt (27.3%); without the Nifty filter worst drop -45%.

title: Low-volatility basket and blends
rules: Lowest 1-year volatility, top 200/500, 30/50 stocks; blends with momentum.
result: 13-15.6%/yr (~Nifty); blends cost return without cutting drops.

title: Momentum: reshuffle every 2 or 3 months (after tax)
rules: Slower reshuffles, buffers top 30/40/50, lot-level tax.
result: After tax 20.7-22.7% vs 22.6% monthly; quarterly = half the trading but worst drop -41%.

title: Momentum: let winners run (no trims)
rules: Kept stocks are not trimmed back to 5%.
result: +0-0.2 pt after tax, deeper drops.

title: Momentum score: skip the last month
result: 21.7% vs 22.6% after tax (honest).

title: Momentum score: more weight on 6 months
rules: (2 x 6m + 12m)/vol.
result: 21.3% after tax.

title: Momentum score: no volatility divisor
result: 20.0% after tax.

title: Momentum score: residual momentum
rules: 12-1 return beyond what Nifty explains / residual vol.
result: 19.6% after tax, worst drop -26% (smaller).

title: Momentum score: Clenow 90-day slope x R-squared
rules: Exponential trend slope x fit.
result: 14.8% after tax.

title: Momentum: smooth-trend filter (frog in the pan)
rules: Top 40 by score, keep the 20 smoothest climbers.
result: 21.6% after tax, worst drop -27%.

title: Factor index rotation (Momentum / Alpha / Low Vol)
rules: Rotate between rebuilt factor indices by 6/12-month return.
result: Adds 0-1 pt over holding one; factors move together.

title: Large vs mid vs small switch
rules: Monthly switch to the best size index.

title: Nifty / gold / liquid switch
rules: Hold the best of Nifty, gold, liquid by trailing return.

title: Nifty vs gold ratio rule
rules: Monthly: 30/70 Nifty/gold when Nifty is expensive vs gold (z > 1 vs 5-year average), 100% Nifty when cheap, else 60/40.
result: 2009-2026 15.3%/yr, worst -26% vs Nifty 14.1% / -38%; after tax 12.2% vs 13.3% (switching taxed yearly).
verdict: Better for tax-free money; maybe later.

title: India intraday (60-day test)
rules: Intraday rules on NSE 5-minute data.
result: No edge.
